limitations: Photo-based reconstruction with documented horizontal envelope. No survey/as-built fidelity, live clearance, stage, hydraulics, material condition or complete reproduction of the surrounding town is claimed.

user_supplied_aerial_reference.use: Reference only. Crest-to-forward-leaf and crest-to-counterweight links meet shared joints; the long moving arm joins rear and forward joints. First leaf panels and narrow crest walkway fitted visually. Photographer, capture date and source URL not supplied; image not redistributed.

riverfront_setting.use: East/tender-house-side roofed marina north of bridge, curving levee roads, low village/farm buildings, agricultural parcels and mixed leafy/bare riparian cover are original procedural visual reconstructions. Boat/slip counts, dimensions, positions, materials and foliage are authored; no current inventory, surveyed property boundary, species or season is asserted.
riverfront_setting.assets: Original boat/building/road/grass geometry and original soil noise. Existing licensed reservoir tree bakes and CC0 rock maps retain their notices. Reference image is not bundled.

photo_fitted_geometry: Fixed-span splits, elevation above illustrative water, steel sections, link pivots, counterweight sizes, pier/fender geometry and setting location are authored estimates fitted to photos. East pony length uses the documented 101-foot span. Model represents a closed bridge, not its current operating condition.
